status: AWAITING OWNER AUTHORIZATION FOR THESE EXACT IMAGES
changes: Bare S3 RX now invokes the pinned SDK receive-enable flag after direct PHY enable and clears it before PHY disable. Idle boot and balanced power-domain ownership remain.

S3 TX adds an IRQ-enabled fast paced loop using precomputed rational DRAM deadlines. It retains source-word order when late and reports achieved rate, backlog and unsent tail; existing raw/generic loop bodies are unchanged.

S3 TX uses checked whole-line USB output and source CRC checks around startup, tone setup, timed loops and teardown. Word/delta buffers are populated after all SDK startup/tone setup. A source-memory change is distinct from receiver BER.

fast_loop.scope: ELF software loop placement/call audit, not physical RF throughput

validation.scope: Host/ELF/build evidence, not new physical throughput or RF verification

write_scope: Application-only at 0x10000, after rechecking each owned MAC, retained table, capacity and image hash. No bootloader, partition table, NVS or eFuse write. Retained table capacities above are independent of build-default partition CSVs.

test_scope.rate_scope: Requests through the nominal CPU-cycle clock, not a claimed attainable store or RF rate. Fast rejects masking/traces and preserves words instead of skipping individual source bits; overload remains failure to attain the requested rate.
test_scope.references: Generic gate at1M/2.208M and unpaced references; finite framed multichannel PDM cases include requested2.208Msymbol/s (4ch48kHz OSR8 and24kHz stereo OSR32),4.416Msymbol/s (4ch48kHz OSR16) and8.832Msymbol/s (4ch48kHz OSR32). These are requested test clocks, not attained-rate claims.
test_scope.receiver_scope: Two finite native IQ snapshots at nominal16/40/80MS/s with deferred USB, not continuous capture. Bare PHY first; explicitly selected WiFi NULL fallback if bare tuning still fails, preserving failed setup.
test_scope.temperature_scope: Explicit driver readings outside timed windows; not independently calibrated or continuous thermal stress data.
test_scope.compatibility_scope: Four settings with three repetitions and finite1s bursts: ASK100k,ASK1M,Gate1M with requested2000us masks,andASK1M with requested2000us masks. Trace capacity2048,stride0. Re-test prior masked TX prefix loss and checked output/cleanup; actual mask intervals are reported. Requested masks remain below20ms.

end_state: Restore the approved kernel/audio profilers on COM22 and COM23 after the finite campaign; leave the requested metal TX role on COM13 (original application COM14). The disconnected classic CYD remains untouched.
limitations: New images have no physical performance result before authorization and execution.
CPU/IQ clocks are nominal; register/software timing is not RF edge timing, synchronized one-way latency or ultimate PHY bandwidth.
Finite snapshots have explicit deadtime; no continuous on-board audio ADC/DAC or end-to-end audio latency proof.
SDK setup/teardown and integrity observers can exceed requested payload duration; no independent hard RF-cessation measurement.
CRC checkpoints do not exclude transient changes/collisions. Teardown-only changes are not assigned to earlier RF BER.
Board brand, antennas, placement and single-unit variation are not causally isolated.
